name: tabularium
description: Venue-qualified credit-event releases rebuilt from preserved source records.

interface.shortDescription: Venue-qualified credit-event releases rebuilt from preserved source records.
interface.longDescription: Tabularium turns preserved Goldfinch borrow and repay entities into deterministic canonical JSONL without discarding the source meaning or native record behind a row. Its coverage manifest binds the raw source, capture manifest and canonical ledger, declares mapped and unsupported entity counts, and names the hosted-indexer and block-proof gaps. Verification uses only local files, confines every path to the release directory and rebuilds expected event bytes rather than trusting the release's row claims.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $tabularium to build and verify a source-bound Goldfinch credit-event release.
